title: preserve-arch-torrents → main
diff:
diff --git a/lib/cdimage/tests/test_tree.py b/lib/cdimage/tests/test_tree.py
index a9daeae..bf814e2 100644
--- a/lib/cdimage/tests/test_tree.py
+++ b/lib/cdimage/tests/test_tree.py
@@ -3983,6 +3983,110 @@ class TestFullReleasePublisher(TestCase, TestReleasePublisherMixin):
 
     @mock.patch("cdimage.osextras.find_on_path", return_value=True)
     @mock.patch("subprocess.call", side_effect=call_mktorrent_zsyncmake)
+    def test_publish_release_keeps_torrents_of_other_arches(
+        self, mock_call, *args
+    ):
+        # An architecture can be published by its own publish-release
+        # invocation, so publishing one architecture must not drop the
+        # torrents of architectures that were published before it.
+        self.config["PROJECT"] = "kubuntu"
+        self.config["CAPPROJECT"] = "Kubuntu"
+        series = Series.latest()
+        try:
+            version = series.pointversion
+        except Exception:
+            version = series.version
+        self.config["DIST"] = series
+        daily_dir = os.path.join(
+            self.temp_dir,
+            "www",
+            "full",
+            "kubuntu",
+            series.full_name,
+            "daily-live",
+            "20130327",
+        )
+        self.capture_logging()
+        for official, status, prefix in (
+            ("named", "release", "kubuntu-%s" % version),
+            ("named", "beta-2", "kubuntu-%s-beta2" % version),
+            ("named", "release/snapshot-2", "kubuntu-%s-snapshot2" % version),
+            ("no", "beta-2", str(series)),
+            ("no", "release/snapshot-2", str(series)),
+        ):
+            publisher = self.get_publisher(official=official, status=status)
+            torrent_dir = publisher.torrent_dir("daily-live", "desktop")
+            for arch in "amd64", "i386":
+                self.config["ARCHES"] = arch
+                for ext in "iso", "manifest", "iso.zsync":
+                    touch(
+                        os.path.join(daily_dir, "%s-desktop-%s.%s" % (series, arch, ext))
+                    )
+                publisher.publish_release("daily-live", "20130327", "desktop")
+
+            self.assertCountEqual(
+                [
+                    "%s-desktop-amd64.iso" % prefix,
+                    "%s-desktop-amd64.iso.torrent" % prefix,
+                    "%s-desktop-i386.iso" % prefix,
+                    "%s-desktop-i386.iso.torrent" % prefix,
+                ],
+                os.listdir(torrent_dir),
+                msg="OFFICIAL=%s STATUS=%s" % (official, status),
+            )
+
+    @mock.patch("cdimage.osextras.find_on_path", return_value=True)
+    @mock.patch("subprocess.call", side_effect=call_mktorrent_zsyncmake)
+    def test_publish_release_drops_torrents_of_other_releases(
+        self, mock_call, *args
+    ):
+        # Torrents belonging to a different release (for example an older
+        # point release) are still purged when publishing.
+        self.config["PROJECT"] = "kubuntu"
+        self.config["CAPPROJECT"] = "Kubuntu"
+        series = Series.latest()
+        try:
+            version = series.pointversion
+        except Exception:
+            version = series.version
+        self.config["DIST"] = series
+        self.config["ARCHES"] = "amd64"
+        daily_dir = os.path.join(
+            self.temp_dir,
+            "www",
+            "full",
+            "kubuntu",
+            series.full_name,
+            "daily-live",
+            "20130327",
+        )
+        touch(os.path.join(daily_dir, "%s-desktop-amd64.iso" % series))
+        touch(os.path.join(daily_dir, "%s-desktop-amd64.manifest" % series))
+        touch(os.path.join(daily_dir, "%s-desktop-amd64.iso.zsync" % series))
+        torrent_dir = os.path.join(
+            self.temp_dir,
+            "www",
+            "torrent",
+            "kubuntu",
+            "releases",
+            series.name,
+            "release",
+            "desktop",
+        )
+        touch(os.path.join(torrent_dir, "kubuntu-0.0-desktop-s390x.iso.torrent"))
+        self.capture_logging()
+        publisher = self.get_publisher(official="named")
+        publisher.publish_release("daily-live", "20130327", "desktop")
+        self.assertCountEqual(
+            [
+                "kubuntu-%s-desktop-amd64.iso" % version,
+                "kubuntu-%s-desktop-amd64.iso.torrent" % version,
+            ],
+            os.listdir(torrent_dir),
+        )
+
+    @mock.patch("cdimage.osextras.find_on_path", return_value=True)
+    @mock.patch("subprocess.call", side_effect=call_mktorrent_zsyncmake)
     def test_publish_release_simplestreams(self, mock_call, *args):
         self.config["PROJECT"] = "kubuntu"
         self.config["CAPPROJECT"] = "Kubuntu"
diff --git a/lib/cdimage/tree.py b/lib/cdimage/tree.py
index c835104..ef40a94 100644
--- a/lib/cdimage/tree.py
+++ b/lib/cdimage/tree.py
@@ -3858,8 +3858,6 @@ class ReleasePublisher(Publisher):
             # Prepare torrent trees for publication.
             torrent_dir = self.torrent_dir(source, publish_type)
             if not self.config["CDIMAGE_NO_PURGE"]:
-                if self.want_dist:
-                    self.remove_tree(torrent_dir)
                 if self.want_full:
                     # Drop the torrents of every other status of this
                     # release.  A status may be a nested path
@@ -3872,7 +3870,14 @@ class ReleasePublisher(Publisher):
                         entry_path = os.path.join(torrent_releases_dir, entry)
                         if entry != keep and os.path.isdir(entry_path):
                             self.remove_tree(entry_path)
-                    self.remove_tree(torrent_dir)
+                # Drop torrents of other releases, but keep the other
+                # architectures of this release (published separately).
+                # Match the filenames chosen by publish_release_arch.
+                torrent_prefix = prefix_status if self.want_dist else prefix
+                kept_prefix = "%s-%s-" % (torrent_prefix, publish_type)
+                for entry in osextras.listdir_force(torrent_dir):
+                    if not entry.startswith(kept_prefix):
+                        self.remove(os.path.join(torrent_dir, entry))
             os.makedirs(torrent_dir, exist_ok=True)
 
         logger.info("Constructing release trees ...")
